vulnerabilityAlerts.prHeader:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Security fix, opened without the 5-day wait**
>
> Renovate opened this PR because a published advisory affects the current version. It skipped the [**minimum release age** (`minimumReleaseAge`)](https://docs.renovatebot.com/key-concepts/minimum-release-age/) check, so the fixed version might be younger than 5 days. Read the advisory below, check the release age and the upstream release, then merge by hand.
>
> This exception is configured in [renovate.json](https://github.com/aignostics/python-sdk/blob/main/renovate.json).

description: Lock file maintenance has no release timestamp, so timestamp-required holds it forever.
Remove this rule when renovatebot/renovate#46645 is released.
The SDK is deprecated and gets only bug and security fixes until it is retired.
vulnerabilityAlerts.enabled forces fix PRs through this rule.
Lock file maintenance stays on: it updates vulnerable transitive dependencies. This rule does not match it.
